angle: Job postings as finder: welder/fitter/fabricator postings naming e-houses, PDCs, electrical/control buildings, skids, modular data-center modules, switchgear enclosures, mobile substations, containment, racks; employer resolved to plant via employer's own site; public job-board JSON APIs (nVent Workday cxs, Mission Critical Group SmartRecruiters) used for site placement
searches_until_dry: not reached; stopped at the ~30-search budget. Searches 29 (prefabricated data center welder) still surfaced new leads (mostly unnamed employers); searches 1, 6, 13, 17 and 30 returned nothing new
notes: Counts (in_definition and plant_confirmed): core 14, boundary 5, pre-production 1. Core: Quality Electrical Systems (QES); Cummings Electrical Integrated Manufacturing; Modular Mission Critical (M.C. Dean modular manufacturing center); Panelmatic Houston (PEC/PDC plant); Panelmatic Conroe; Panelmatic Brookfield; Powell Industries Jacintoport facility; PCX Clayton (headquarters & manufacturing); PCX Knightdale manufacturing facility; Wunderlich-Malec Winslow plant; Wunderlich-Malec Baldwin facility; Vertiv Pelzer facility; nVent e-house plant Pittsburg; nVent e-house plant Millington. Boundary: Module X Solutions; REAMCO (Rivers Electrical Services) Childersburg; Harvard Integrations; Delta Star East (Lynchburg); Mission Critical Group North Wales metal shop. Pre-production: nVent Goodyear engineered-buildings plant.

Search log: 1 e-house welder (none); 2 PDC skid welder; 3 modular data center welder; 4 switchgear enclosures welder; 5 electrical buildings/e-houses welder; 6 mobile substation welder (none); 7 data-center skids power modules; 8 base welder switchgear; 9 server rack frames welder; 10 structural welder E-House PDC Texas; 11 power/electrical skids LA OK; 12 containment welder; 13 indeed e-house (none); 14 modular power data center 2026; 15 fitter welder electrical house; 16 control buildings substation; 17 ziprecruiter E-Houses (none new); 18 mobile substation manufacturer welder; 19 PCR/PDC building/walk-in enclosure; 20 cooling base frame/skid welder; 21 aluminum enclosures welder; 22 Vertiv Pelzer; 23 nVent welder Houston/Tulsa/Chattanooga; 24 MCG welder e-house; 25 nVent EPG facility locations; 26 Farmingdale server-rack employer; 27 Protect Controls; 28 Nortek DCC plant; 29 prefabricated data center welder; 30 E-Room/power skids PA OH IN (none).

Most posting URLs were expired (404/410) or bot-walled (iHire, Monster, CareerBuilder, jobright, inferencejobs, buildsubmarines, Workable 429). Quotes were therefore taken from employer pages where possible; quote_verified reflects fetch_page.py --check on the listed url.

Unnamed-employer leads NOT in plants (employer not named on any page): Aerotek 2nd-shift welder/fitter building metal framework for switchgear cabinets; Birmingham AL maker of control panels and turnkey substation control buildings (ZipRecruiter); Farmingdale NY and Lindenhurst NY steel frames/cabinets for server rooms (Aerotek); Houston contract structural welder for modular cooling skids (iHire); energyjobline Pasadena/SE Houston welder/fitter for skids for electrical control panels; Randstad Houston enclosures/switchracks; Texas Trades Decatur AL HAX (containment) systems shop welder; Prologistix Salt Lake City data-center containment manufacturer; Itasca IL enclosure builder for data center projects; Resource MFG Houston engineered skids client.

Named leads not resolved to a site (not counted): Cummings Electrical Pampa TX and Muskogee OK career-filter locations; Mission Critical Group BLC1 site; Switchgear Solutions; Elliott Industries (Bossier City LA, site fetch failed); Wedlake/Enclosure Welder Tulsa OK; Munters Daleville VA (welder 'assembling and bolting'); Silent-Aire/Johnson Controls journeyman welder modular data-center cooling; Swanton Welding data-center skids; Interstates electrical skids; Roeslein PDCs; Panelbuilt substation buildings; Encore Electric fabrication; FSW Denver containment framing; AccuTrex server cabinets; Trayer Engineering (Siemens) vacuum switchgear; nVent Workday welder sites Oshkosh WI, Eastanollee GA (modular buildings per snippet), Hitchcock TX, Fulton MO (Switchgear Systems per snippet), Chattanooga TN, Centralia IL, Anoka MN, Eleanor WV where postings do not name the product.

Out-of-definition leads seen: TAR Odessa off-grid power plant; xAI/SpaceX field welders; Nomad GCS mobile ops centers; FluidStack welding engineer; Sunbelt Solomon transformers; PACK Power / MasTec / Dacon field substation bus welders; Southern Industrial (EMCOR) Coppell field project; Holt Industrial skid & packaging; R717 refrigeration skids; Saber Power field aluminum bus.

Blind spots of this method: plants not currently hiring welders, or hiring only through staffing agencies that hide the employer; expired postings; bot-walled job boards; postings that say 'welder' without naming the product; postings that name a product but not the site (big multi-plant parents such as nVent, Vertiv, MCG); and pre-production plants, which post few production welder jobs.
Quote checks: every row with url+quote was re-run through tools/fetch_page.py --check on 2026-11-19 and quote_verified set from the result (Powell contact page needs --browser).
